name: University Oaks Shopping Center
summary: University Oaks Shopping Center is a 236,506 square foot community retail destination in Round Rock, Texas, featuring a convenient mix of furniture stores, clothing retailers, and fast-food restaurants. Professionally managed by InvenTrust Properties, this well-regarded center serves the growing Austin-Round Rock metro area with everyday shopping essentials.
demographics: University Oaks Shopping Center serves the rapidly growing Round Rock community in the Austin-Round Rock metro area, attracting a diverse mix of young professionals, families, and university-affiliated visitors. The trade area benefits from Williamson County's above-average household incomes and strong population growth driven by tech sector employment and the presence of major employers in the region. Primary shoppers include middle to upper-middle income households seeking convenient access to everyday essentials, furniture, and quick-service dining options. The center's location near major thoroughfares makes it a popular destination for both local residents and commuters seeking accessible retail and dining conveniences.
description: University Oaks Shopping Center is a well-established community retail destination located at 201 University Oaks Boulevard in Round Rock, Texas, serving the thriving Austin-Round Rock metropolitan area. Spanning 236,506 square feet, this open-air shopping center has become a cornerstone of convenience for local residents, offering a carefully curated collection of well-known everyday shops specializing in furniture, clothing, and fast-food dining options. Situated in Williamson County, one of the fastest-growing counties in Texas, the center benefits from its strategic location with excellent accessibility and visibility along major traffic corridors. The property is professionally managed by InvenTrust Properties, a leader in essential retail real estate, ensuring consistent quality and tenant mix that meets the daily needs of the community. With a strong 4.4-star rating from over 4,000 reviews, University Oaks Shopping Center has earned its reputation as a reliable shopping destination where families and professionals can efficiently accomplish their shopping needs in a welcoming, well-maintained environment.
